text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime minister says Kuwait's national security and economic reforms are the priorities of the new government.
- Frequent malfunctions hit the Kuwait Stock Exchange automated trading system due to high trade volume.
- Kuwaiti and Japanese businessmen to meet in Japan on October 21 to discuss investment opportunities.
- A group of parliamentarians to meet on Thursday to discuss speaker's post. The new 50-seat parliament starts its four-year term on Sunday.
- The International Committee of the Red Cross urges Iraq to cooperate on detainees issue. Kuwait says Iraq still holds about 600 Kuwaitis and nationals of Third World countries. Iraq denies that.
